sources.title: Externalities: Prices Do Not Capture All Costs
sources.author: Thomas Helbling; IMF Finance & Development
sources.sections: Private and wider costs/benefits; public-goods discussion, body paragraphs corresponding to retrieved lines 221–253
sources.supported_use: Distinguish an agreed cost from an effect outside the price, and examine public-good properties.
sources.limits: Historical educational article; author views are not necessarily IMF policy. No meeting impact, environmental footprint or full-cost valuation is measured. Original X4 and T8 cases are not source findings.

sources.title: What is macroeconomics?
sources.author: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System; updated 22 August 2025
sources.sections: Short body definition of economy-wide activity, growth, employment, inflation and policy
sources.supported_use: Establish the economy-wide level of analysis.
sources.limits: No current national statistics, personal forecast or linked video inspected. The basket, labor-force and output figures are fictional.

sources.title: Monetary Policy: Stabilizing Prices and Output
sources.author: Koshy Mathai; IMF Finance & Development
sources.sections: Body discussion of policy distinctions, interest-rate transmission and lags, retrieved lines 225–260
sources.supported_use: Explain possible monetary transmission without inferring a cause from one indicator.
sources.limits: Historical examples and descriptions of operating frameworks are not a current central-bank manual. No present interest rate, policy prescription or institution-specific rule adopted. Author views are not necessarily IMF policy.

sources.title: Fiscal Policy: Taking and Giving Away
sources.author: Mark Horton and Asmaa El-Ganainy; IMF Finance & Development
sources.sections: Spending, taxes, borrowing, automatic stabilizers, discretionary response, lags and fiscal space; selected body paragraphs 221–244 and 259
sources.supported_use: Separate fiscal channels and financing constraints from household accounting and monetary policy.
sources.limits: Historical crisis material, not current fiscal data, tax rules or a recommended national policy. Author views are not necessarily IMF policy. No tax schedule or debt sustainability assessment performed.

sources.title: Negative Interest Rates: A Tax in Sheep’s Clothing
sources.author: Christopher J. Waller; Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, 2 May 2016
sources.sections: Opening explanation of tax incidence and the difference between remitting a tax and bearing its burden
sources.supported_use: Distinguish collection responsibility from economic incidence.
sources.limits: Only the opening incidence concept is used. Historical speaker views are not an institutional policy position; negative-rate policy arguments, charts and country rates are not adopted. No actual pass-through estimate or tax advice.

sources.title: Social protection
sources.author: International Labour Organization
sources.sections: Introduction on life-course risks and contributory/tax financing; branch descriptions for health, unemployment, old age, family and disability
sources.supported_use: Compare covered risks, financing approaches and access barriers.
sources.limits: Landing-page body only, not underlying reports, thematic pages, current coverage statistics or a real eligibility/benefit determination. Pool S8, costs and applicant journey are original fiction.

sources.title: Launch your business — Choose a business structure
sources.author: U.S. Small Business Administration
sources.sections: Structure section: sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation, nonprofit and cooperative, retrieved body lines 177–244
sources.supported_use: Provide introductory distinctions among capital, control and mission arrangements.
sources.limits: U.S. educational context; local legal, tax, liability and registration details remain unverified. A nonprofit can earn revenue and pay staff; no automatic exemption or lawful formation is inferred. Redirect destination counted once.

sources.title: Employee Ownership Initiative
sources.author: U.S. Department of Labor, Employee Benefits Security Administration
sources.sections: Landing-page body identifying employee ownership, ESOPs, worker cooperatives and employee ownership trusts
sources.supported_use: Distinguish a financial ownership stake from governance rights that need actual documents.
sources.limits: The deeper employee-ownership tool page returned 403 and is not credited. Landing-page definitions do not establish automatic democratic voting, legal plan terms, grant availability or an actual ownership arrangement.

sources.title: Professional and active SOE ownership
sources.author: OECD; Ownership and Governance of State-Owned Enterprises 2024, chapter 1
sources.sections: Selected chapter passages on definition, state ownership/control, economic activity, public-policy objectives and accountability, retrieved lines 3834–3856
sources.supported_use: Compare public enterprise with other forms without treating every public service as an enterprise.
sources.limits: Selected passages only, not the full chapter, report, underlying guidelines or jurisdictional formation law. No current ownership statistics or universal governance prescription adopted.

sources.title: Framework for responsible research and innovation
sources.author: UKRI EPSRC; updated 20 January 2026
sources.sections: Page discussion of anticipating, reflecting, engaging and acting, including context and uncertainty
sources.supported_use: Connect impact questions, affected perspectives and an enforceable revision or stop decision.
sources.limits: No linked research paper, certification or product validation. R8 is an original paper trial; no deployed AI service, real data, actual affected-user test or compliance result.

sources.title: International Trade: Commerce among Nations
sources.author: Brad McDonald; IMF Finance & Development
sources.sections: Body discussion of opportunity cost, comparative advantage, distribution and adjustment, retrieved lines 224–266
sources.supported_use: Explain modeled trade gains alongside unequal effects and practical limits.
sources.limits: Historical membership counts, tariff figures and crisis claims are not current data. Author views are not necessarily IMF policy. Original bread/cloth arithmetic is not a forecast or legal trade determination.

sources.title: Basic Information on OFAC and Sanctions
sources.author: U.S. Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control
sources.sections: Introductory FAQs 1, 3, 4 and 6 on sanctions programs and general compliance questions
sources.supported_use: Identify the need for current program-specific authoritative review before a real transaction.
sources.limits: No parties screened, lists checked, regulation applied or license obtained. Educational reading is not transaction permission. No actual shipment is planned.

sources.title: Export Compliance Programs (ECPs)
sources.author: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security
sources.sections: Introductory compliance-program body and overview of transaction screening, classification and authorization questions
sources.supported_use: Keep export-control review separate from price and opportunity-cost analysis.
sources.limits: No underlying toolkit downloaded, EAR classification made, program certified or transaction authorized. The page does not establish that any proposed source or product is lawful.

sources.title: Start writing fiction
sources.author: The Open University, OpenLearn
sources.sections: Single-page sections 1.3 discussion, 1.5 notebook tips and selected setting discussion; retrieved lines 185–190, 222–230 and 239–258
sources.supported_use: Use ordinary details and actions as material; discuss how chosen particulars can shape a fictional scene.
sources.limits: Selected sections only, not the complete course, literary extracts or audio. The alternate-format route returned 403; the single-page body was read. No evidence that this three-session schedule is a validated habit intervention. Scenes and revisions are original.

sources.title: See, Think, Wonder
sources.author: Project Zero, Harvard Graduate School of Education
sources.sections: Resource-page description of observation, interpretation and curiosity; attribution and license notice
sources.supported_use: Brief conceptual reference for keeping available detail distinct from an interpretation.
sources.limits: CC BY-NC-ND resource: no branded routine or worksheet copied or adapted. O8 prompts, detail map and miniature are original curriculum-based material. No effectiveness study, certification or validated assessment administered.

sources.title: Reading Aloud
sources.author: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill Writing Center
sources.sections: Body discussion of hearing a draft, tone/rhythm, missing words, reading the actual text and limits of a listener without rereading
sources.supported_use: Use another encounter with a work to inspect choices; compare written and marked-performance affordances.
sources.limits: CC BY-NC-ND handout not copied or adapted. Original examples and short conceptual citation only; no recommended software inspected, audio played, actual audience response or required speech/hearing.

sources.title: Considerations for licensors and licensees
sources.author: Creative Commons
sources.sections: Licensee and licensor considerations on rights, particular permissions, conditions and third-party interests

sources.limits: Guidance page only; no legal code opened, specific artwork cleared or legal originality opinion given. Eight-line invitation uses original teaching prompts and fictional facts; no actual event or external work reuse.
